newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen rebounding on Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen rebounding on Wall Street rise.

text.p: French stocks were expected to rebound on Wednesday, bolstered by Wall Street's rise to new all-time highs, brokers said.
The bourse was also expected to welcome the new government's decision to reconsider private pensions proposed by the previous conservative government and better consumer sentiment in France.
* CAC-40 July futures contract traded on GLOBEX up 26 points at 2,963 at 0730 GMT
* CAC index finished down 17.85 points, or 0.61 percent, at 2,929.81 on Tuesday
* Remy Cointreau drops 8.46 percent to 136.3, on disappointment over its 1996/97 results.
* Lyonnaise des Eaux gains 3.34 percent to 619, most actively traded stock, Elf Aquitaine also busy, up 1.65 percent at 678.
